name: sooya
description: SOOYA - single-user, single-persona, single永久会话 private AI chat bot

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sooya/server && npm run build -w @sooya/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sooya/web && npm run dev -w @sooya/server
scripts.dev:parallel: npm run dev -w @sooya/server & npm run dev -w @sooya/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sooya/server && npm run typecheck -w @sooya/web
